items.title: Revisiting somatosensory evoked potentials in motor neuron diseases: neurophysiological insights from a large cohort.
items.summary: To systematically investigate Somatosensory Evoked Potential (SEP) abnormalities in a large cohort of patients with Motor Neuron Disease (MND), and to explore their relationship with Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) and clinical phenotypes. We retrospectively analyzed 267 patients with confirmed MND who underwent standardized SEPs and transcranial magnetic stimulation. Patients were divided into pure/predominant Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) and pure/predominant Lower Motor Neuron/Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (LMN/ALS) groups. SEP abnormalities were assessed using internal normative data, including prolonged latencies, reduced amplitudes, and increased N20-P25 amplitudes. MEPs were classified semi-quantitatively as normal or abnormal by independent raters. At least one SEP abnormality was detected in 75 % of patients, with no significant differences between the UMN and LMN/ALS groups. Increased N20-P25 amplitudes were observed in both phenotypes, suggesting widespread sensory cortical hyperexcitability across the MND spectrum. In contrast, abnormal MEPs were significantly more frequent in UMN patients (p < 0.001). No significant association was found between SEP abnormalities and MEP findings. Upper- and lower-limb SEP latencies were strongly correlated (all p < 0.001), whereas increased SEP amplitudes did not correlate with latency abnormalities. SEP abnormalities are highly prevalent in MND and appear largely independent from corticospinal dysfunction. Increased SEP amplitudes likely reflect primary cortical sensory hyperexcitability rather than impaired sensory conduction. These findings support the concept of MND as a multisystem network disorder that involves sensory cortical circuits and highlight the role of SEPs in the diagnostic workup.
items.titleZh: 重新审视运动神经元病中的体感诱发电位：来自大型队列的神经生理学见解
items.summaryZh: 这项针对267名运动神经元病患者的大型回顾性研究发现，75%的患者存在体感诱发电位异常，且这种异常在上运动神经元为主和下运动神经元/ALS为主的表型中同样普遍。特别值得注意的是，N20-P25波幅增加在两种表型中均出现，提示感觉皮层过度兴奋是MND的普遍特征，而非单纯由运动通路损伤继发。SEP异常与MEP异常无显著关联，表明感觉与运动通路的病理改变相对独立。
items.insight: 该研究为MND不仅是运动系统疾病、而是涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病提供了直接神经生理学证据，提示SEP可能作为评估皮层过度兴奋状态和疾病谱系特征的辅助生物标志物，对理解ALS的病理机制和临床分型具有参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在系统性地调查运动神经元病（MND）患者队列中体感诱发电位（SEP）的异常情况，并探讨其与运动诱发电位（MEPs）及临床表型的关系。研究者回顾性分析了267名确诊的MND患者，这些患者均接受了标准化的SEP和经颅磁刺激检查。患者被分为纯/主要上运动神经元（UMN）组和纯/主要下运动神经元/肌萎缩侧索硬化（LMN/ALS）组。SEP异常通过内部规范数据进行评估，包括潜伏期延长、波幅降低和N20-P25波幅增加。MEPs由独立评估者半定量分类为正常或异常。结果显示，75%的患者至少存在一种SEP异常，UMN组与LMN/ALS组之间无显著差异。两种表型均观察到N20-P25波幅增加，提示MND谱系中存在广泛的躯体感觉皮层过度兴奋。相比之下，异常MEPs在UMN患者中显著更常见（p < 0.001）。SEP异常与MEP发现之间未发现显著关联。上下肢SEP潜伏期强相关（均p < 0.001），而SEP波幅增加与潜伏期异常无相关性。SEP异常在MND中高度普遍，且在很大程度上独立于皮质脊髓功能障碍。SEP波幅增加可能反映原发性皮层感觉过度兴奋，而非感觉传导受损。这些发现支持MND是一种涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病的概念，并强调了SEP在诊断评估中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大型队列数据，揭示了MND中感觉皮层过度兴奋与运动通路功能障碍的独立性，为ALS作为多系统网络疾病的病理模型提供了新近的临床神经生理学证据。

items.title: Chronic neurological diseases with acute respiratory failure in a real-life cohort: insights into ICU and long-term survival-A retrospective study.
items.summary: Patients with chronic neurological diseases (CND) are at increased risk of pulmonary complications that often require ICU admission. This study aimed to identify clinical factors associated with ICU mortality and long-term survival in patients with CND who developed acute respiratory failure (ARF). This retrospective cohort study was conducted in a level III respiratory ICU. Patients with pre-existing CND admitted to the ICU with ARF were included. ICU mortality was analyzed using multivariable logistic regression. Long-term survival after ICU discharge was evaluated using Kaplan-Meier survival analysis and Cox proportional hazards models. Mortality timing was further characterized using hazard function analysis. A total of 220 patients were included; the most common neurological diagnoses were dementia (37.3%), stroke (22.7%), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (14.1%). ICU mortality was 33.6%. Higher APACHE II scores were independently associated with increased ICU mortality (OR 1.076 per point increase; 95% CI 1.029-1.126; p < 0.001). Long-term survival differed significantly by post-discharge respiratory support strategy, with Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrating more favorable survival patterns among patients receiving home non-invasive mechanical ventilation (NIMV) (p = 0.003). In Cox regression analysis, age, home NIMV, and feeding modality at discharge were independently associated with long-term outcomes. Survival analyses revealed an early clustering of deaths within the first months after ICU discharge, particularly among patients with dementia. In patients with CND, acute physiological severity was the main determinant of ICU mortality, whereas long-term survival after ICU discharge was poor, with deaths clustering within the first months thereafter. Post-discharge respiratory support and nutritional management should be individualized according to the expected clinical trajectory and patient values.
items.titleZh: 真实队列中慢性神经系统疾病伴急性呼吸衰竭：ICU及长期生存的见解——一项回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了220名因急性呼吸衰竭入住ICU的慢性神经系统疾病患者，发现ICU死亡率高达33.6%，其中痴呆、卒中和ALS是最常见的基础疾病。急性生理紊乱严重程度（APACHE II评分）是ICU死亡的主要预测因素。出院后接受家庭无创通气的患者长期生存更好，但总体而言，ICU出院后数月内死亡风险较高，尤其在痴呆患者中。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS及其他慢性神经疾病患者发生急性呼吸衰竭后的预后提供了真实世界数据，提示ICU急性期管理决策和出院后呼吸支持策略（如家庭NIMV）可能对长期生存产生重要影响，值得ALS临床团队在规划呼吸支持路径时参考。

items.abstractZh: 慢性神经系统疾病（CND）患者发生肺部并发症的风险增加，常需入住ICU。本研究旨在识别发生急性呼吸衰竭（ARF）的CND患者中与ICU死亡率和长期生存相关的临床因素。这项回顾性队列研究在一家三级呼吸ICU进行。纳入既往患有CND且因ARF入住ICU的患者。使用多变量逻辑回归分析ICU死亡率。使用Kaplan-Meier生存分析和Cox比例风险模型评估ICU出院后的长期生存。使用风险函数分析进一步描述死亡时间特征。共纳入220名患者；最常见的神经系统诊断为痴呆（37.3%）、卒中（22.7%）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（14.1%）。ICU死亡率为33.6%。较高的APACHE II评分与ICU死亡率增加独立相关（每增加1分OR 1.076；95% CI 1.029-1.126；p < 0.001）。长期生存因出院后呼吸支持策略不同而有显著差异，Kaplan-Meier分析显示接受家庭无创机械通气（NIMV）的患者生存模式更有利（p = 0.003）。在Cox回归分析中，年龄、家庭NIMV和出院时喂养方式与长期结局独立相关。生存分析显示ICU出院后最初几个月内死亡早期聚集，尤其在痴呆患者中。在CND患者中，急性生理严重程度是ICU死亡率的主要决定因素，而ICU出院后的长期生存较差，死亡集中在出院后最初几个月内。出院后的呼吸支持和营养管理应根据预期的临床轨迹和患者价值观进行个体化。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的最新真实世界队列数据，直接涉及ALS患者急性呼吸衰竭后的ICU结局与长期生存，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 修复肌萎缩侧索硬化临床试验的可信度缺口
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章指出，ALS早期和中期临床试验中普遍存在夸大疗效宣称的问题，这些宣称往往无法在3期试验中得到验证。作者认为，这种问题源于“临床试验工业复合体”带来的不当激励，导致试验设计、数据解读和结果传播出现系统性偏差。文章呼吁加强方法学严谨性，明确区分假设生成与假设检验，并严格筛选2期项目，以恢复ALS临床试验的可信度。
items.insight: 这篇文章对ALS临床试验领域普遍存在的“过度宣称”现象进行了尖锐批评，并提出了具体的改进建议。对于ALS研究者而言，它提醒我们在解读早期试验结果时保持警惕，并关注试验设计和方法学质量，而非仅关注表面阳性结果。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS早期试验中普遍存在夸大疗效宣称的现象，原因包括不当激励、方法学缺陷和过度乐观解读，需通过严格标准和科学怀疑主义加以纠正。
aiRead.limitation: 作为观点文章，缺乏系统性数据支持，主要基于作者观察和推理。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续ALS临床试验是否采用更严格的报告标准，以及2期项目筛选策略的变化。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）早期和中期的临床试验数据长期被用来宣称临床获益，但这些宣称往往未能在成功的3期试验中转化。本文认为，由“临床试验工业复合体”产生的反常激励助长了错误的科学推理，该复合体极大地影响了试验设计、数据解读和结果传播。反复出现的谬误包括：结果比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标不匹配、结果的选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对不确定数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在工业和学术界错位激励的强化下，导致过早宣称治疗前景，并对患者造成切实伤害。为解决由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度缺口，我们呼吁严格遵守既定的临床试验结果报告标准，明确区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的筛选。转向科学怀疑主义和方法论严谨性的文化转变对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，直接针对ALS临床试验中反复出现的可信度问题，提出方法学和文化层面的改革方向，对ALS药物研发的转化价值具有重要指导意义。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.titleZh: ATXN2谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 本文评论了ATXN2基因相关疾病遗传模式的复杂性。传统认为ATXN2相关疾病以常染色体显性遗传为主，但新发现的隐性遗传家族案例提示，功能缺失机制也可能参与发病。重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量等因素可能改变遗传模式。这对ALS风险分层、遗传咨询和未来治疗策略有重要影响。
items.insight: 该评论文章提示ATXN2相关疾病的遗传模式比以往认知更为复杂，隐性遗传和功能缺失机制的存在可能影响ALS患者的遗传咨询和风险分层策略，值得关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2相关疾病可能不仅限于常染色体显性遗传，在特定情况下（如重复中断、体细胞嵌合、基因剂量变化）可表现为隐性遗传模式，提示功能缺失机制参与发病。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为评论文章，基于对单个家族案例的分析，缺乏大规模人群验证数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对ATXN2隐性遗传家族的大规模队列研究，以及功能缺失机制在ALS发病中作用的功能学验证研究。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2的遗传复杂性挑战了神经退行性疾病的传统范式。虽然最初与常染色体显性脊髓小脑共济失调2型相关，但ATXN2 CAG重复扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier等人描述了一个具有ATXN2相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，挑战了长期以来以常染色体显性、功能获得性机制为主的假设。在此，我们分析了ATXN2的遗传模式如何可能因重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能缺失机制在某些情况下参与发病。我们讨论了这对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，强调遗传分层的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该评论基于2026年最新发表的家族案例，挑战了ATXN2相关疾病以显性遗传为主的传统观点，对ALS遗传分层具有直接转化价值。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here, we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on the most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过系统性文献回顾和计算机模拟分析，筛选出15个与ALS相关的环状RNA候选分子，发现它们参与调控未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期和凋亡等ALS相关通路，并可能通过海绵吸附20种RNA结合蛋白发挥作用。研究还发现ALS相关FUS突变会改变其与circRNA的结合能力，且患者组织RNA-seq数据支持这些circRNA宿主基因表达的改变。
items.insight: 该研究为circRNA在ALS发病机制中的作用提供了系统性的生物信息学证据，特别是揭示了circRNA与FUS突变之间的相互作用，提示circRNA可能作为散发性ALS的潜在生物标志物或治疗靶点，值得ALS研究者关注后续的功能验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，特别是环状RNA（circRNAs），在疾病发生和进展中的作用。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元疾病（MNDs）有关的circRNAs。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能，随后进行了系统性文献回顾以识别与ALS相关的circRNAs，并基于最有力的数据对15个circRNA候选分子进行了计算机模拟分析。结果显示，多个环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡等通路。蛋白质-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNAs可海绵吸附20种RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析显示，ALS相关的FUS变异显著改变其与circRNAs的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在ALS受累的中枢神经系统中，ALS相关circRNAs的宿主基因及核心蛋白的表达存在显著改变。综上，我们的发现将circRNAs确定为ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，结合系统文献回顾与多维度计算机模拟分析，为circRNA在ALS中的调控网络提供了新近的整合性见解，具有明确的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Nuclear SOD1 links ATM-CHK2 signaling to ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A cellular models of ALS.
items.summary: The activity of S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (ADH5/GSNOR) has been proposed being essential to limit oxidative stress and preserve mitochondrial quality control. Here we identify a redox-dependent ATM-CHK2-SOD1 signaling axis that drives ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SH-SY5Y cells expressing the ALS-associated SOD1 G93A mutant. ATM-CHK2 activation promotes the interaction of SOD1 with CHK2, leading to SOD1 nuclear translocation and binding to the ADH5 promoter. Pharmacological inhibition of ATM or CHK2 abolishes these effects. ADH5/GSNOR overexpression protects cells from SOD1 G93A -induced toxicity suggesting that the modulation of GSNOR activity may represent a potential strategy to restore redox homeostasis in ALS.
items.titleZh: 核SOD1将ATM-CHK2信号与ALS SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A细胞模型中的ADH5/GSNOR转录联系起来
items.summaryZh: 这项细胞研究发现了一条新的信号通路：在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变的细胞中，ATM-CHK2信号激活后，会促使SOD1进入细胞核并结合到ADH5/GSNOR基因的启动子上，从而启动该基因的转录。ADH5/GSNOR是一种抗氧化酶，其过表达能减轻SOD1突变带来的细胞毒性。用药物抑制ATM或CHK2可以阻断这一过程。该研究提示，通过增强GSNOR活性来对抗氧化应激，可能成为ALS的潜在治疗方向。
items.insight: 该研究首次将DNA损伤应答核心激酶ATM-CHK2与SOD1的核功能及抗氧化基因ADH5/GSNOR的转录调控直接联系起来，为SOD1突变型ALS中氧化应激与核信号转导的交叉对话提供了新的分子机制，并指出了GSNOR作为可干预靶点的可能性。

aiRead.limitation: 研究仅在单一细胞系（SH-SY5Y）中进行，缺乏体内动物模型验证；且未明确ATM-CHK2激活的上游氧化还原信号具体来源。

items.abstractZh: S-亚硝基谷胱甘肽还原酶（ADH5/GSNOR）的活性被认为对于限制氧化应激和维持线粒体质量控制至关重要。本研究在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变体的SH-SY5Y细胞中，鉴定出一条氧化还原依赖的ATM-CHK2-SOD1信号轴，该信号轴驱动ADH5/GSNOR的转录。ATM-CHK2的激活促进SOD1与CHK2的相互作用，导致SOD1核转位并结合至ADH5启动子。药理学抑制ATM或CHK2可消除这些效应。ADH5/GSNOR的过表达可保护细胞免受SOD1 G93A诱导的毒性，提示调节GSNOR活性可能代表一种在ALS中恢复氧化还原稳态的潜在策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了SOD1在细胞核内的新转录调控功能，为SOD1相关ALS的氧化还原失衡机制提供了新的可干预信号轴，具有直接的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Cumulative environmental burden and neurodegenerative disease mortality: a national ecological study in the United States.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs) represent a growing cause of mortality and disability among aging populations worldwide. However, the relationship between cumulative, multidomain environmental exposures, and NDD mortality remains poorly characterized. This study aimed to examine the association between comprehensive environmental quality and NDD mortality in the United States. We used the environmental quality index (EQI) from 2000 to 2005 to characterize cumulative environmental exposure. Associations between EQI quintiles and NDD mortality, including dementia, Parkinson's disease (PD), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and Huntington's disease, were examined using Bayesian interval-censored mixed-effects models. During 2006-2020, among 3.66 million NDD deaths, poorer environmental quality (Q5 vs Q1) was associated with mortality rate differences of 24.72 (95% credible intervals [CrI]: 22.43, 27.06) per 100 000 at 5-year lag, 26.74 (95% CrI: 24.34, 29.21) at 10-year lag, and 22.74 (95% CrI: 20.49, 25.13) at 15-year lag. Within each lag period, a clear dose-response pattern was consistently observed across EQI quintiles. Furthermore, associations were most pronounced for the air quality, followed by sociodemographic disadvantage. In addition, demographic and geographic heterogeneity was observed across sex, race, census regions, urbanicity, climate zone, and county economic type. These findings underscore the need for integrated, place-based environmental health policies targeting neurodegeneration prevention.
items.titleZh: 累积环境负担与神经退行性疾病死亡率：美国全国生态学研究
items.summaryZh: 这是一项覆盖美国全国的大规模生态学研究，分析了2000-2005年的综合环境质量与2006-2020年间神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）死亡率的关系。结果发现，环境质量越差，痴呆、帕金森病、ALS和亨廷顿病的死亡率越高，且呈明显剂量-反应关系。其中空气污染的影响最强，社会人口劣势次之。不同性别、种族和地区的人群受影响程度不同。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS研究者提供了重要的流行病学背景：环境因素并非单一暴露，而是多种因素（空气、水、土地、社会人口等）的累积效应。其剂量-反应关系和长达15年的滞后效应提示，环境暴露可能在ALS发病和进展中扮演比以往认知更重要的角色，值得在ALS的病因学研究和患者管理中加以关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: 较差的环境质量与NDD（含ALS）死亡率显著增加相关，呈剂量-反应关系，空气污染贡献最大，滞后效应可持续15年。
aiRead.limitation: 生态学研究存在生态谬误风险，无法推断个体层面的因果关系；EQI数据来自2000-2005年，可能未完全反映后续环境变化；未单独报告ALS亚组的具体效应量。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否开展针对ALS的单独环境暴露队列研究，以及空气污染具体成分（如PM2.5、重金属）与ALS发病风险的个体层面关联研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs）是全球老龄化人口中日益增长的死亡和残疾原因。然而，累积的、多领域的环境暴露与NDD死亡率之间的关系仍缺乏充分描述。本研究旨在考察美国综合环境质量与NDD死亡率之间的关联。我们使用2000年至2005年的环境质量指数（EQI）来表征累积环境暴露。采用贝叶斯区间删失混合效应模型，检验EQI五分位数与NDD死亡率（包括痴呆、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和亨廷顿病）之间的关联。在2006-2020年期间，在366万例NDD死亡中，较差的环境质量（Q5 vs Q1）与死亡率差异相关：5年滞后期为每10万人24.72例（95%可信区间[CrI]：22.43, 27.06），10年滞后期为26.74例（95% CrI：24.34, 29.21），15年滞后期为22.74例（95% CrI：20.49, 25.13）。在每个滞后期内，EQI五分位数间均一致观察到明显的剂量-反应模式。此外，空气质量的关联最为显著，其次是社会人口劣势。另外，在性别、种族、人口普查区域、城市化程度、气候带和县级经济类型方面观察到人口学和地理异质性。这些发现强调了针对神经退行性变预防的综合性、基于地方的环境健康政策的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2000-2020年美国全国数据，首次系统评估了多领域累积环境负担与ALS等神经退行性疾病死亡率的剂量-反应关系，具有重要的环境流行病学转化价值。

items.title: Mechanistic Characterization of NABi as a Selective Inhibitor of SOD1G93A Aggregation: Structural Basis and Therapeutic Implications for ALS.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a devastating neurodegenerative disease characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with familial ALS (fALS) frequently caused by mutations in Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase (SOD1). The G93A mutation, one of the most aggressive forms, promotes the formation of cytotoxic protein aggregates through cross-β-sheet structures, leading to neuronal dysfunction and death. In this study, we investigated the therapeutic potential of NABi (natural Aβ binder and Aβ-aggregation inhibitor), a stable small engineered protein composed of the N-terminal 90 amino acids of SOD1, originally developed to target amyloid-β aggregation in Alzheimer's disease. Given the shared β-sheet-rich aggregation mechanisms between amyloid-β and mutant SOD1 proteins, we hypothesized that NABi could serve as a dual-action therapeutic for both diseases. Through an integrated approach involving structural, biochemical, and cellular analyses, we demonstrate that NABi exhibits a 4-fold greater binding affinity for SOD1G93A compared to SOD1WT, selectively targeting the mutant protein via specific hydrophobic interactions. Structural modeling using AlphaFold2 reveals that the G93A mutation exposes hydrophobic residues that create an optimal binding interface for NABi. Functionally, NABi effectively inhibits SOD1G93A aggregation, as demonstrated by filter trap assays and immunofluorescence microscopy, while maintaining the protein in a soluble, nontoxic state. Importantly, coexpression of NABi reduces SOD1G93A-induced cytotoxicity by approximately 4-fold, significantly enhancing neuronal survival. These findings establish NABi as a promising therapeutic candidate for SOD1G93A-associated familial ALS, demonstrating its capacity to selectively target pathological protein conformations while preserving normal cellular function. Our results support the development of NABi as an innovative pan-therapeutic approach targeting shared aggregation pathways across multiple neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: NABi作为SOD1G93A聚集选择性抑制剂的机制表征：ALS的结构基础与治疗意义
items.summaryZh: 这项研究测试了一种名为NABi的小型工程蛋白能否抑制ALS中最具侵袭性的SOD1G93A突变蛋白的聚集。结果显示，NABi对突变蛋白的结合力是正常SOD1蛋白的4倍，能有效阻止有毒聚集体的形成，并将细胞毒性降低约4倍。该蛋白最初是为阿尔茨海默病设计的，提示不同神经退行性疾病可能存在可共同靶向的聚集机制。
items.insight: 这项研究值得ALS研究者关注，因为它提出了一种基于共享β-折叠聚集机制的双重用途治疗策略：一个原本针对阿尔茨海默病Aβ聚集的工程蛋白，被重新定位为SOD1相关ALS的潜在治疗药物，并展示了选择性靶向突变蛋白而非正常蛋白的能力，这对减少副作用具有重要意义。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种毁灭性的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，家族性ALS（fALS）常由Cu/Zn超氧化物歧化酶（SOD1）突变引起。G93A突变是最具侵袭性的形式之一，通过交叉β-折叠结构促进细胞毒性蛋白聚集体的形成，导致神经元功能障碍和死亡。本研究探讨了NABi（天然Aβ结合剂和Aβ聚集抑制剂）的治疗潜力，NABi是一种由SOD1 N端90个氨基酸组成的稳定小工程蛋白，最初为靶向阿尔茨海默病中的淀粉样β聚集而开发。鉴于淀粉样β和突变SOD1蛋白之间共享富含β-折叠的聚集机制，我们假设NABi可作为这两种疾病的双重作用治疗药物。通过结构、生化和细胞分析的综合方法，我们证明NABi对SOD1G93A的结合亲和力比SOD1WT高4倍，通过特异性疏水相互作用选择性靶向突变蛋白。使用AlphaFold2的结构建模揭示，G93A突变暴露了疏水残基，为NABi创造了最佳结合界面。在功能上，NABi有效抑制SOD1G93A聚集，如过滤陷阱测定和免疫荧光显微镜所证明，同时保持蛋白质处于可溶性、无毒状态。重要的是，NABi的共表达将SOD1G93A诱导的细胞毒性降低约4倍，显著增强神经元存活。这些发现确立了NABi作为SOD1G93A相关家族性ALS的有前景治疗候选药物，证明其选择性靶向病理蛋白构象同时保留正常细胞功能的能力。我们的结果支持将NABi开发为一种创新的泛治疗策略，靶向多种神经退行性疾病中共有的聚集途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，利用AlphaFold2结构建模指导设计，展示了跨疾病共享聚集途径的转化治疗潜力，为SOD1相关ALS提供了新的候选药物方向。

items.title: Implementation of specialised care improves survival in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Access to multidisciplinary care influences survival in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (pwALS). However, real-world data comparing structured specialised care with general neurological management remain limited. We aimed to assess the influence of implementing a specialised outpatient clinic on survival in pwALS. This retrospective cohort study included pwALS meeting the Gold Coast criteria who were treated at the Department of Neurology of the Medical University of Vienna between January 2009 and July 2023. Demographic and clinical parameters and survival data were obtained from the local ALS registry, the Austrian Federation of Social Insurance databases, and the national mortality database of Statistik Austria. Data were censored in December 2024. Outcomes were compared between patients managed before (general care cohort) and after the establishment of a specialised ALS outpatient clinic in 2018 (specialised care cohort). A total of 242 pwALS were included (47.5% female), of whom 43.8% received general neurological care and 56.2% specialised care. Spinal onset ALS was observed in 65.1% and 70.6%, respectively. Baseline demographic and clinical characteristics were comparable between both cohorts. Median survival time was 27.0 months (95% CI 23.0-35.0) in the general care cohort and 40.0 months (95% CI 32.0-47.0) in specialised care cohort (p = 0.0173). This survival difference was driven by patients with spinal onset ALS, whereas no benefit was observed in those with bulbar onset disease. Specialised care was associated with improved survival in this real-world ALS cohort, likely reflecting the cumulative effect of coordinated multidisciplinary management rather than individual interventions.
items.titleZh: 专业化护理的实施可改善肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者的生存率
items.summaryZh: 这项来自维也纳医科大学的大型回顾性研究（2009-2023年，242名患者）发现，在2018年建立专业ALS门诊后，患者中位生存期从27个月延长至40个月，差异具有统计学意义。生存获益主要见于脊髓起病患者，球部起病患者未见明显改善。研究提示，结构化的多学科专业护理模式可能比单一治疗手段更能带来生存获益。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS专科门诊模式的价值提供了真实世界证据，提示多学科综合管理可能带来近一年的中位生存获益，这对优化ALS诊疗服务布局和临床路径具有直接参考意义。

items.abstractZh: 获得多学科护理会影响肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者（pwALS）的生存率。然而，比较结构化专业护理与普通神经内科管理的真实世界数据仍然有限。我们旨在评估实施专业门诊对pwALS生存率的影响。这项回顾性队列研究纳入了2009年1月至2023年7月期间在维也纳医科大学神经内科接受治疗、符合Gold Coast标准的pwALS患者。人口统计学和临床参数及生存数据来自当地ALS登记处、奥地利社会保险联合会数据库和奥地利统计局国家死亡率数据库。数据在2024年12月进行审查。比较了2018年专业ALS门诊建立前（普通护理队列）和建立后（专业护理队列）管理的患者的结果。共纳入242名pwALS患者（47.5%为女性），其中43.8%接受普通神经内科护理，56.2%接受专业护理。脊髓起病ALS在两组中分别占65.1%和70.6%。两组基线人口统计学和临床特征具有可比性。普通护理队列的中位生存时间为27.0个月（95% CI 23.0-35.0），专业护理队列为40.0个月（95% CI 32.0-47.0）（p = 0.0173）。这一生存差异主要由脊髓起病的ALS患者驱动，而球部起病患者未观察到获益。在该真实世界ALS队列中，专业护理与生存率改善相关，这可能反映了协调的多学科管理的累积效应，而非单一干预措施的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2024年12月审查的最新长期随访数据，直接比较了专业多学科护理与常规神经科管理的真实世界生存差异，为ALS临床服务模式优化提供了高转化价值的证据。

items.title: Establishment of a novel human nervous system tissue bank: University of Debrecen tissue bank-introduction and retrospective data analysis.
items.summary: Human brain tissues obtained from autopsies, as well as muscle and nerve samples derived from biopsies, constitute indispensable resources for translational research investigating the pathomechanisms of neuropsychiatric disorders. In this study, we introduce the Nervous System Tissue Bank of University of Debrecen, which contains formalin-preserved and formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) brain samples, as well as frozen nerve and muscle biopsy specimens. Database was established containing clinical and pathological parameters. For autopsy cases, the following variables were recorded: sex, age, number of hospitalization days, admission diagnosis, comorbidities, cause of death, post-mortem interval, general autopsy findings, and macro- and microscopic brain pathology diagnoses. For biopsy samples, we recorded: sex, age, biopsy site, and microscopic and molecular genetic diagnoses. Based on the recorded parameters and their temporal changes, retrospective statistical analyses were performed. Formalin-fixed brain samples and FFPE blocks were available from 2425 deceased individuals, and nerve/muscle samples from 257 patients. The brain samples originate from the period between 1990 and 2012. The most frequent admission diagnoses included ischemic stroke (n = 1070), hemorrhagic stroke (n = 462), subarachnoid hemorrhage (n = 102), epilepsy (n = 103), brain metastasis (n = 70), primary brain tumor (n = 60), parkinsonism (n = 28), dementia (n = 21), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (n = 21). Prevalence of hypertension (67.6%) and diabetes mellitus (20.1%) showed a significant increase over time (p < 0.001), whereas the prevalence of malignancies, dementia, parkinsonism, and psychiatric disorders remained stable. Our tissue bank represents the largest nervous system collection in Hungary, providing well-characterized brain, muscle, and nerve samples linked to nearly three decades of clinical data. Samples are made available to researchers.
items.titleZh: 新型人类神经系统组织库的建立：德布勒森大学组织库介绍及回顾性数据分析
items.summaryZh: 匈牙利德布勒森大学建立了该国最大的神经系统组织库，包含2425例尸检脑样本和257例神经/肌肉活检样本，时间跨度近三十年。该库详细记录了临床和病理数据，其中包含21例ALS病例。高血压和糖尿病患病率随时间显著上升。该资源为ALS等神经退行性疾病的病理机制和生物标志物研究提供了宝贵的转化研究材料。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者而言，该组织库的价值在于其将长期、详细的临床数据与高质量的神经和肌肉组织样本相结合。特别是肌肉和神经活检样本，对于研究ALS的周围神经和肌肉病理变化至关重要，而脑样本则有助于理解疾病的中枢机制。此类资源是验证新发现的生物标志物和探索疾病异质性的关键。

items.abstractZh: 来自尸检的人脑组织以及来自活检的肌肉和神经样本，是研究神经精神疾病病理机制的转化研究中不可或缺的资源。本研究介绍了德布勒森大学神经系统组织库，该库包含福尔马林保存和福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）的脑样本，以及冷冻的神经和肌肉活检标本。研究建立了包含临床和病理参数的数据库。对于尸检病例，记录了以下变量：性别、年龄、住院天数、入院诊断、合并症、死亡原因、尸检间隔时间、一般尸检结果以及宏观和微观脑病理诊断。对于活检样本，记录了：性别、年龄、活检部位以及微观和分子遗传学诊断。基于记录的参数及其时间变化，进行了回顾性统计分析。研究获得了来自2425名 deceased 个体的福尔马林固定脑样本和FFPE块，以及来自257名患者的神经/肌肉样本。脑样本来源于1990年至2012年期间。最常见的入院诊断包括缺血性卒中（n=1070）、出血性卒中（n=462）、蛛网膜下腔出血（n=102）、癫痫（n=103）、脑转移瘤（n=70）、原发性脑肿瘤（n=60）、帕金森综合征（n=28）、痴呆（n=21）和肌萎缩侧索硬化症（n=21）。高血压（67.6%）和糖尿病（20.1%）的患病率随时间显著增加（p < 0.001），而恶性肿瘤、痴呆、帕金森综合征和精神疾病的患病率保持稳定。该组织库是匈牙利最大的神经系统样本收藏，提供与近三十年临床数据相关联的、特征明确的脑、肌肉和神经样本。样本可供研究人员使用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究通过建立包含近三十年临床数据的大型生物样本库，为ALS等神经退行性疾病的转化研究提供了新近的、高价值的资源平台。

items.title: C9orf72-associated poly-GR in skeletal muscle leads to neuromuscular junction deficits and muscle atrophy.
items.summary: Hexanucleotide repeat expansions in C9orf72 produce dipeptide repeat (DPR) proteins that are widely expressed, including in the nervous system and skeletal muscle. Among these DPRs, arginine-containing proteins, poly-GR and poly-PR, are toxic in the nervous system, but whether DPRs in skeletal muscle contribute to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) pathogenesis is unclear. Here, we show that muscle-restricted expression of poly-GR drives motor deficits in mice, including muscle atrophy and neuromuscular junction (NMJ) deficits. Poly-GR in muscle interacted with the NMJ key organizer MuSK and promoted MuSK degradation, disrupting postsynaptic structure and impairing neuromuscular transmission. Importantly, a MuSK agonist antibody (X-17) stabilized NMJs and rescued neuromuscular transmission. Moreover, poly-GR in muscle activated the integrated stress response (ISR), elevating eIF2α phosphorylation and broadly suppressing protein translation. ISR inhibition with ISRIB restored translation and MuSK protein levels and ameliorated both muscle atrophy and NMJ deficits. These findings demonstrate that skeletal muscle actively contributes to C9orf72-ALS pathology. Targeting muscle with ISRIB offers a therapeutic strategy to preserve motor function in C9orf72-ALS.
items.titleZh: C9orf72相关poly-GR在骨骼肌中导致神经肌肉接头缺陷和肌肉萎缩
items.summaryZh: 这项在小鼠模型中进行的研究发现，C9orf72突变产生的poly-GR蛋白在骨骼肌中积累时，会通过与MuSK蛋白相互作用并促使其降解，破坏神经肌肉接头的结构和功能，同时激活整合应激反应抑制蛋白质合成，最终导致肌肉萎缩和运动缺陷。研究还发现，使用ISRIB抑制整合应激反应或使用MuSK激动剂抗体X-17，可以恢复蛋白翻译和MuSK水平，改善肌肉萎缩和神经肌肉接头缺陷。该研究提示骨骼肌本身是C9orf72-ALS病理的重要参与者，而靶向肌肉的ISRIB可能是一种潜在的治疗策略。
items.insight: 这项研究首次明确证明骨骼肌中表达的poly-GR蛋白本身即可驱动ALS相关病理，而非仅仅被动受神经退行影响，将治疗靶点从神经系统扩展到骨骼肌外周组织，为C9orf72-ALS提供了新的干预思路。

items.abstractZh: C9orf72中的六核苷酸重复扩增产生二肽重复蛋白（DPR），这些蛋白广泛表达，包括在神经系统和骨骼肌中。在这些DPR中，含精氨酸的蛋白poly-GR和poly-PR在神经系统中具有毒性，但骨骼肌中的DPR是否参与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的发病机制尚不清楚。在此，我们证明肌肉限制性表达poly-GR可驱动小鼠的运动缺陷，包括肌肉萎缩和神经肌肉接头（NMJ）缺陷。肌肉中的poly-GR与NMJ关键组织者MuSK相互作用并促进MuSK降解，破坏突触后结构并损害神经肌肉传递。重要的是，一种MuSK激动剂抗体（X-17）稳定了NMJ并挽救了神经肌肉传递。此外，肌肉中的poly-GR激活了整合应激反应（ISR），升高eIF2α磷酸化并广泛抑制蛋白质翻译。用ISRIB抑制ISR可恢复翻译和MuSK蛋白水平，并改善肌肉萎缩和NMJ缺陷。这些发现表明骨骼肌积极参与C9orf72-ALS的病理过程。以ISRIB靶向肌肉为在C9orf72-ALS中保留运动功能提供了一种治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了poly-GR在骨骼肌中的直接致病机制并验证了两种干预策略，具有明确的ALS转化治疗价值。

items.title: Context-dependent roles of osteopontin in aging-related neurological disorders.
items.summary: Osteopontin (encoded by secreted phosphoprotein 1) is a multifunctional matricellular phosphoglycoprotein that has emerged as an important mediator in the aging nervous system. During aging, osteopontin interacts with microglial priming, vascular remodeling, myelin repair, and innate immune responses and is consistently implicated in major late-life neurological disorders. However, its biological effects are highly context dependent. Depending on its cellular source, proteolytic processing, receptor interactions, anatomical distribution, and disease stage, osteopontin may either exacerbate chronic neuroinflammation and tissue injury or promote phagocytic clearance, neuronal survival, remyelination, neuroplasticity, and tissue repair. This review critically synthesizes studies indexed in PubMed and Google Scholar through 3 April 2026 on the role of osteopontin in brain aging, Alzheimer's disease and related dementias, Parkinson's disease and Lewy body disorders, cerebrovascular disease, vascular cognitive impairment, cerebral small vessel disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In Alzheimer's disease, cerebrospinal fluid and plasma osteopontin concentrations increase from the prodromal to symptomatic stages, whereas microglial or perivascular secreted phosphoprotein 1 expression correlates with amyloid pathology, synaptic remodeling, and cognitive decline. However, under specific conditions, osteopontin also enhances macrophage-mediated amyloid-beta clearance. In stroke, elevated circulating osteopontin predicts poor clinical outcomes, whereas experimental studies demonstrate that appropriately timed exogenous osteopontin, regulatory T cell-derived osteopontin, and osteopontin-mediated autophagic and reparative pathways promote white-matter repair, peri-infarct plasticity, and blood-brain barrier integrity. Evidence from Parkinson's disease, Lewy body disease, frontotemporal dementia, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis further supports the role of osteopontin as both a candidate biomarker and a regulator of selective neuronal vulnerability. Rather than being uniformly detrimental or protective, osteopontin should be regarded as a context-dependent regulator of age-related neuroimmune remodeling. This perspective reconciles seemingly conflicting findings and supports the development of therapeutic strategies that are tailored to disease stage, protein fragment, and cell type rather than broadly targeting osteopontin.
items.titleZh: 骨桥蛋白在衰老相关神经系统疾病中的情境依赖性作用
items.summaryZh: 骨桥蛋白在衰老相关神经疾病中的作用复杂且情境依赖，既可能促进神经炎症和组织损伤，也可能支持修复和神经保护。在ALS中，骨桥蛋白可能作为候选生物标志物，并参与选择性神经元脆弱性的调节。综述强调，未来治疗应针对疾病阶段、蛋白片段和细胞类型进行精准干预，而非简单抑制或增强骨桥蛋白。

items.abstractZh: 骨桥蛋白（由分泌型磷蛋白1编码）是一种多功能基质细胞磷酸化糖蛋白，已成为衰老神经系统中重要的介质。在衰老过程中，骨桥蛋白与小胶质细胞预激活、血管重塑、髓鞘修复和先天免疫反应相互作用，并持续与主要的晚年神经系统疾病相关联。然而，其生物学效应高度依赖于情境。根据其细胞来源、蛋白水解加工、受体相互作用、解剖分布和疾病阶段，骨桥蛋白可能加剧慢性神经炎症和组织损伤，或促进吞噬清除、神经元存活、髓鞘再生、神经可塑性和组织修复。本综述批判性地综合了截至2026年4月3日PubMed和Google Scholar索引的研究，涉及骨桥蛋白在脑衰老、阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆、帕金森病和路易体病、脑血管病、血管性认知障碍、脑小血管病以及肌萎缩侧索硬化中的作用。在阿尔茨海默病中，脑脊液和血浆骨桥蛋白浓度从前驱期到症状期增加，而小胶质细胞或血管周围分泌型磷蛋白1表达与淀粉样病理、突触重塑和认知衰退相关。然而，在特定条件下，骨桥蛋白也增强巨噬细胞介导的淀粉样蛋白-β清除。在卒中中，循环骨桥蛋白升高预示不良临床结局，而实验研究表明，适时给予外源性骨桥蛋白、调节性T细胞来源的骨桥蛋白以及骨桥蛋白介导的自噬和修复通路可促进白质修复、梗死周围可塑性和血脑屏障完整性。来自帕金森病、路易体病、额颞叶痴呆和肌萎缩侧索硬化的证据进一步支持骨桥蛋白作为候选生物标志物和选择性神经元脆弱性调节因子的作用。骨桥蛋白不应被视为统一有害或保护性，而应被视为年龄相关神经免疫重塑的情境依赖性调节因子。这一观点调和了看似矛盾的发现，并支持开发针对疾病阶段、蛋白片段和细胞类型量身定制的治疗策略，而非广泛靶向骨桥蛋白。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了截至2026年的最新研究，明确骨桥蛋白在ALS等疾病中的情境依赖性作用，强调其作为生物标志物和精准治疗靶点的转化价值。

items.title: Possible Paraneoplastic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Presenting as Respiratory Failure in a Breast Cancer Patient: A Case Report.
items.summary: A 63-year-old female with metastatic breast cancer presented with acute hypercapnic respiratory failure secondary to severe diaphragmatic dysfunction and mixed upper and lower motor neuron signs. Serum onconeural and neural surface antibody panels were negative, and initial cerebrospinal fluid analysis revealed albuminocytologic dissociation. Immunotherapy with intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) produced no clinical improvement, necessitating invasive mechanical ventilation and gastrostomy. Applying the 2021 PNS-Care consensus criteria, the case fulfills criteria for possible paraneoplastic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), although coincidental sporadic disease cannot be excluded. A markedly elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) was observed, largely attributable to skeletal metastases and localized pulmonary collapse. Clinicians must maintain a high index of suspicion for motor neuron disease in cancer patients with unexplained hypoventilation.

items.titleZh: 乳腺癌患者以呼吸衰竭为首发表现的可能副肿瘤性肌萎缩侧索硬化：病例报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一位63岁转移性乳腺癌女性患者，以急性呼吸衰竭为首发表现，最终被诊断为可能的副肿瘤性ALS。患者血清和脑脊液副肿瘤抗体阴性，IVIG治疗无效，需依赖呼吸机。该病例提示，在癌症患者中出现不明原因的低通气或呼吸衰竭时，应考虑运动神经元病（包括副肿瘤性ALS）的可能性，即使抗体检测阴性也不能排除。
items.insight: 该病例对ALS研究者具有跟踪价值，因为它展示了副肿瘤性ALS的复杂临床表现（以呼吸衰竭为主），并强调了现有诊断标准（PNS-Care）在临床实践中的应用，同时提示抗体阴性并不能排除副肿瘤性病因，为副肿瘤性ALS的早期识别和鉴别诊断提供了重要线索。

aiRead.keyFinding: 乳腺癌患者出现急性呼吸衰竭和运动神经元体征，符合可能的副肿瘤性ALS标准，但抗体阴性且IVIG无效。
aiRead.limitation: 单个病例，无法排除偶发性散发性ALS；缺乏肿瘤组织或神经病理学确认；抗体检测范围有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注副肿瘤性ALS的更大样本研究，以及针对副肿瘤性病因的免疫治疗策略（如肿瘤切除或更早的免疫调节）的疗效评估。

items.abstractZh: 一名63岁女性转移性乳腺癌患者因严重膈肌功能障碍及上、下运动神经元混合体征，出现急性高碳酸血症性呼吸衰竭。血清副肿瘤性神经抗体和神经表面抗体检测均为阴性，初次脑脊液分析显示白蛋白-细胞分离。静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIG）免疫治疗未见临床改善，需行有创机械通气和胃造口术。应用2021年PNS-Care共识标准，该病例符合可能的副肿瘤性肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）标准，但不能排除偶发性散发性疾病。观察到红细胞沉降率（ESR）显著升高，主要归因于骨骼转移和局部肺不张。临床医生对癌症患者出现不明原因低通气时应高度警惕运动神经元病。
items.frontierRationale: 该病例报告发表于2026年，聚焦于副肿瘤性ALS这一罕见且易误诊的表型，其以呼吸衰竭为首发症状的临床特征对ALS早期识别具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: A standardized framework resolves ambiguity in motor neuron loss across neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Motor neuron (MN) loss is a hallmark of neurodegenerative disorders, yet its assessment remains variable, confounding mechanistic and therapeutic interpretation. To address this, we conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) mouse studies, revealing 60% variability in reported MN loss, for which spinal cord sampling emerged as a major contributor. Using a whole-segment approach with tissue clearing, MN tracing, and multimodal imaging, we confirmed segment-dependent differences in MN counts. Common MN markers (SMI-32, Nissl) lacked specificity, whereas choline acetyltransferase (ChAT) provided robust labeling in murine and human spinal cords. Deep learning-based whole-mount segmentation enabled unbiased MN quantification and validated manual counts. Integrating analysis with computational modeling established segment sampling as a key driver of variability and revealed degeneration patterns: widespread MN loss in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), selective MN loss in severe SMA, and preservation in mild SMA models. These findings establish a framework for reproducible MN quantification.
items.titleZh: 标准化框架消除神经退行性疾病中运动神经元丢失评估的模糊性
items.summaryZh: 该研究通过系统回顾和荟萃分析发现，SMA小鼠模型中运动神经元丢失的报道存在高达60%的变异性，主要源于脊髓取样位置的不同。研究者开发了一套标准化流程，结合组织透明化、ChAT标记和深度学习分割，实现了全节段、无偏的MN定量。应用该方法发现ALS表现为广泛的MN丢失，而严重SMA为选择性丢失，轻度SMA则保留。该框架有望提高跨研究可比性。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS研究者提供了运动神经元定量的标准化工具，解决了长期存在的跨研究结果不一致问题，有助于更准确地评估治疗干预效果和疾病进展。

aiRead.limitation: 主要基于SMA小鼠模型数据，ALS相关结论可能受限于模型差异；深度学习分割需进一步验证跨实验室通用性。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该框架在ALS临床试验生物标志物中的应用，以及是否被其他实验室采纳并验证。

items.abstractZh: 运动神经元（MN）丢失是神经退行性疾病的标志，但其评估方法仍存在差异，干扰了机制和治疗解释。为此，我们对脊髓性肌萎缩（SMA）小鼠研究进行了系统回顾和荟萃分析，发现所报告的MN丢失存在60%的变异性，其中脊髓取样是主要影响因素。采用全节段方法结合组织透明化、MN示踪和多模态成像，我们确认了MN计数存在节段依赖性差异。常用MN标志物（SMI-32、Nissl）缺乏特异性，而胆碱乙酰转移酶（ChAT）在小鼠和人类脊髓中提供了稳健的标记。基于深度学习的整体封片分割实现了无偏的MN定量，并验证了手动计数。将分析与计算建模相结合，确定节段取样是变异性的关键驱动因素，并揭示了退化模式：肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中广泛的MN丢失，严重SMA中选择性MN丢失，以及轻度SMA模型中的保留。这些发现为可重复的MN定量建立了框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合最新深度学习与组织透明化技术，针对ALS和SMA中运动神经元评估的长期方法学瓶颈提出标准化方案，具有直接的转化价值。
